Read this first — it is your requirements, with the exact file contents to use verbatim: /home/jmbonilla/workspace/kersy/.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-15-phase-1-agent-map/task-1-brief.md

Work in /home/jmbonilla/workspace/kersy on the current branch (feat/phase-1-agent-map). The docs/ directory already exists — don't touch it.

Global constraints that bind you:

When done: run a self-review of your diff, then commit with the message from the brief. Write your full report (what you did, deviations, verification output) to /home/jmbonilla/workspace/kersy/.superpowers/sdd/2026-08-15-phase-1-agent-map/task-1-report.md

Return ONLY: status (DONE / DONE_WITH_CONCERNS / NEEDS_CONTEXT / BLOCKED), commit hash(es), one-line test summary, and concerns if any.

23	- **Never merge without a clean Copilot review.** Request it: `gh api -X POST repos/<org>/<repo>/pulls/<n>/requested_reviewers -f "reviewers[]=Copilot"` (login is literally `Copilot`). **Always open the "Comments suppressed due to low confidence" block** — on PR #2 it caught a real `ResolveStoreProfile` port-stripping bug 3× while the visible list mentioned it once. 24	- **CI/infra is DevOps's** — diagnose and hand over, do NOT edit workflows/lockfiles to chase red CI (owner rule).

26

All 14 Copilot comments were fixed or rebutted with threaded replies; CI went green after three owner-approved fixes (PHP 8.5 in ci.yml + `composer.json` floor `^8.4.1`; test `APP_KEY` in phpunit.xml; `withoutVite()` in the base TestCase). Feature work continues from `development`; the granular history lives on `feat/phase-0-scaffold`.
28	
29	**Merge mechanics discovered:** `development` is protected by **rulesets, not classic branch protection** (classic API 404s). Two traps: (1) a commit-message rule **rejects `Co-Authored-By: (Claude|Anthropic|Copilot|GPT)` trailers** — the very trailers our commits carry — so a regular merge of the branch is impossible; squash with a clean message is the compliant path. (2) the `copilot_code_review` (review_on_push) rule keeps the PR **permanently BLOCKED** when Copilot refuses the diff (>20k lines), so even squash needed `gh pr merge --admin` (owner-chosen). For future PRs: keep them under 20k lines and either drop the AI trailer or expect squash-only merges.
30	
31	**Owner decisions made:** merchant/seller-center chat is **KEPT** (own phase, not yet built). All 4 tenants day one. Reverb over Pusher (free/self-hosted). SES for send (Gmail-API send is quota-blocked at their volume) + `messages.insert(threadId, SENT)` so replies show in the support Gmail app too.
32	
33	**Researched, awaiting go-ahead:** replace the legacy widget-close→`resolved` conflation with **`resolved` (agent judgment, reopens on reply, triggers CSAT) / `abandoned` (customer left, no CSAT but tracked as abandonment-rate) / `closed` (automation-only terminal lock)** — per Zendesk's model. Caveat: surveying only resolved convos **biases CSAT upward**, so abandonment needs its own metric.
34	
35	**⚠️ Copilot gate — amended 2026-08-15.** The original rule (wait for Copilot's re-review after every push) is dead for PR #2: the PR grew to **40.5k added lines and Copilot refuses anything over 20k** ("exceeds the maximum number of lines"), even net of lockfiles (~21.9k). Owner decision 2026-08-15: **a local full-PR code review substitutes for the Copilot gate on PR #2** (lockfiles/docs excluded). For future PRs the Copilot rule stands — keep them under 20k lines so it can run. Still never merge on green CI alone.
36	
37	**2026-08-15 session (after e2af0d9 fixed the 14 Copilot comments):** pushed 3 more commits — refactor (DB-guard/proxy simplification), **parallel Pest** (paratest; worker-token-suffixed harness DBs; `composer test` and CI run `--parallel`; ~186s→~90s; serial = `composer test:serial`), and **UTC/timezone** (MySQL session pinned `+00:00` via `DB_TIMEZONE`; `tenant.timezone` shared to Inertia; `setDisplayTimeZone()` renders absolute times in market zone; trap: neither Eloquent nor query builder converts a zoned Carbon — callers must `->utc()`). Suite now **76 Pest + 115 Vitest**. Owner explicitly approved the CI edit (recorded in `.ai/rules/workflows.md`).
38	
39	**2026-08-15 later:** local full-PR review (Copilot substitute) found 11 confirmed findings — all fixed with regression tests (tenant-scoped notification channel, redis cache/session defaults, atomic chat counters via lockForUpdate, snippet→full-message reconcile + new `GET /api/chats/{chat}/messages/{message}`, UUID-tenant brand check, customer_ref validation, inactive-assignee guard, S3 write failure throws, broadcastType, normalizeOriginHost). Suppressed-comment sweep of all 17 Copilot rounds fixed the rest (endOfDay CSAT `to` bound, tenant-brand footer, chat disk defaults s3, Tenant no-domain error, per_page clamps, provider return types). Final suite **87 Pest + 116 Vitest**. Standing rule recorded in repo `.ai/rules/general.md`: run simplifier+Pint+ESLint+tests after every edit.
40

42
